scope: EffectCraft CPU solids and nested precomposition stress; isolated release build
statistics: Median and nearest-rank p95. Fresh-process runs retain normal OS filesystem caches. Warm runs reuse one renderer after one excluded warmup.
phases: Renderer calls, RGBA conversion/hash, PNG writes, process wall time and FFmpeg encoding measured separately
limits: Repeated timings cover five sampled frames, not full-sequence repetitions. No matched AE benchmark, GPU, font/effect-heavy stress or speedup claim.
